unitAI-il2io.description:
PROBLEM: Child spawn dies before turn 0: pi refuses to load extension because Tool python conflicts between the dev path (/home/dawid/dev/core/packages/pi-extensions/extensions/python-kernel) and the published copy (node_modules/@jaggerxtrm/pi-extensions/.../python-kernel). Both register tool python. Evidence: repeated exit-code-1 failures on unitAI-9tawb live runs. This blocks every live researcher run using that extension set.

SUCCESS: The dev and published copies never both register; either the loader dedups (one wins, recorded which) or the conflict surfaces once with an actionable message instead of killing the spawn. Live researcher run passes extension load.

SCOPE: Verify first whether the double-load comes from operator config (both paths enabled, e.g. user.json extensions incl. the dev path) or loader behavior; then fix at the right layer -- config guidance/dedup or loader dedup. Specialists and core repos as evidence dictates; coordinate, do not fork core-owned loader code without a core-side bead.

NON_GOALS: Exa/researcher changes; forensic seq race (sibling bead).

CONSTRAINTS: No silent tool shadowing -- if one copy wins, log which. Suite green, tsc clean on touched repos.

VALIDATION: Live researcher extension-load pass recorded on unitAI-9tawb.

OUTPUT: Fix or config change plus findings in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
